accent.description: Either { preset: <id of a colour field> } or { custom: '#rrggbb' }. Accent presets: teal, blue, violet, pink, red, orange, yellow, green, neutral. Tint presets (window, container, text, component): neutral, warm, cool, green, violet, rose.

Search the password manager by title, tag name or folder name. Returns id, title, tag names, folder name and whether the entry has a one-time code. It never returns usernames, addresses or any secret, and there is no way to read one.

query.description: Words to look for in the title, the tag names and the folder name of an entry; every word must match.

tag.description: Only entries that carry this tag.

limit.description: At most this many entries (at most 50, 20 by default).

Call it first to learn where to list or search. A storage the user names but that is not listed can be used as "storage:<name>"; holzi asks the user then.
List the entries of a folder: name, path, kind (file or dir), size in bytes and the time of the last change. At most `limit` entries (500 by default); `truncated` says there are more.

description: Search a folder and everything below it for file and folder names like `query`; small typos still match. Filters: `types`, `sizeMin`/`sizeMax` in bytes, `modifiedAfter`/`modifiedBefore` as YYYY-MM-DD. At most 500 hits, best first; the search stops after 30 seconds, and `truncated` says it did not finish. Hidden files are left out.

An image is shown to you if your model accepts images. For anything else, a scanned PDF or a file over 50 MB you get the details of the file and a `note` why there is no text.
